notes: Coverage: Presbytery of Philadelphia congregations in the City of Philadelphia, from the presbytery's Our Churches list (the page has a Load More button and a second read found no further Philadelphia entries, so the list may be incomplete). First Presbyterian Church in Philadelphia and First Presbyterian Church in Germantown were skipped because they are already on file. First Presbyterian Church of Kensington did not resolve. United Methodist: the conference's food ministry map (read in full) lists seven Philadelphia church programs. Each church's own site was checked and recorded. The conference site has no church directory. The Grace Cafe at 55 North Broad Street, also on that map, is run by The Center rather than a congregation, so it is outside this lane and not recorded. United Church of Christ: Old First United Church of Christ is recorded from its own site. Three other Philadelphia UCC churches came from a third-party listing with no own website and are in leads_only. The PSEC directory was empty, the Keystone Conference directory did not load, and the PSEC Philadelphia Association page says it has 19 churches without listing them. American Baptist: the Philadelphia Baptist Association directory lists about 80 Philadelphia congregations with addresses and phone numbers but no websites, and does not say which are American Baptist. All are in leads_only, unchecked. The two Enon Tabernacle entries share one phone number. Sites with a support group (the AA calendar at Old Pine Street, recovery groups at Somerton) are not recorded as support groups. Copyright footers were never used as evidence. Budget: all 3 WebSearch calls and 59 of 60 fetches used. Process note: this file was moved by the import step during the run, and an earlier copy with the first 30 records may still be in research/hold-running/w13-congregations/ or the import logs. This inbox file is the complete version and supersedes that copy.
